project.name: AI视觉检测平台
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Industrial AI detection platform, neutral gray background + forest green accent, Inter + Noto Sans SC, dense functional layout with tight spacing, restrained surfaces with border-first depth
project.designRead: Desktop industrial tool / AI engineers & operators / calm professional utility / high density / avoid playful rounded shapes

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: single forest-green hue for primary CTA and active states
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: no secondary/accent; categories use neutral tints

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: tight radius (2-8px max), square inputs, minimal rounding
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter + Noto Sans SC, 13px body, monospace for data/logs
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: border-first cards, minimal shadow, table-driven data
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: border-only for static surfaces, shadow only for dropdowns/modals

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: top header bar with logo + menu items, tab bar below with 4 tabs (active tab has green accent strip), status bar at bottom with GPU info
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: forest green #1B5E3B for primary actions, active states, and selection indicators
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Inter 13px body, 15px headings, JetBrains Mono for log/code
sharedProjectShellContract.radiusScale: 2px for controls, 6px for cards, 8px for panels
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: 1px border for cards/surfaces, no box-shadow on static elements
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: compact solid green buttons with 32px height, subtle hover state
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: tight 12px margins, 10px internal spacing, consistent toolbar heights

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Industrial tool aesthetic with forest green accent, tight dense layout, border-first surfaces

pages.title: 数据管理
pages.businessScenario: Import video/image assets, preview with annotation overlay, manage YOLO-format labels
pages.visualNorthStar: Three-column functional layout: asset list | media preview with detection boxes | label manager

pages.title: 模型管理
pages.businessScenario: List/manage models, view details, configure and run fine-tuning training
pages.visualNorthStar: Upper model table + details panel, lower collapsible training configuration with progress log

pages.title: 推理检测
pages.businessScenario: Configure inference settings, run detection on image/video/camera, view results table
pages.visualNorthStar: Left config sidebar with model/source/params, right side split between preview canvas and results table

pages.title: Jetson部署
pages.businessScenario: Select model, configure export options, generate TensorRT/ONNX deployment package
pages.visualNorthStar: Clean vertical flow: action toolbar > model selector > collapsible advanced options > deployment guide > verify section
